steps: Use claude plugin list --json to check the installed VPSnet plugin and its source.
For the VPSnet marketplace installation, run claude plugin update vpsnet@vpsnet in your own terminal.
Use /reload-plugins in the running session or start a new session. For another install source, use its native update control.
Open Customize > Plugins. For an added marketplace, use Check for updates where available.
Uploaded or organization-managed plugins follow their owner's upload, sync and review process. A GitHub release alone does not prove the account's plugin updated.
Manage the account plugin in Customize > Plugins using the source's native update controls.
For an organization marketplace, ask its owner to upload or re-sync and complete any required review. The served version can remain pinned or await approval.
Manage the custom remote connection at grok.com/connectors.
The official connector guide does not establish plugin ZIP updates or a tool-cache refresh command. A remote gateway deployment does not establish whether this conversation refreshed its tools.
Use codex plugin list --json to inspect installed and available plugin versions and the configured marketplace name.
For that configured marketplace, use codex plugin marketplace upgrade <marketplace-name> --json, then start a new session. Do not assume the active thread reloads plugins.
For a custom MCP connection, open its plugin settings, use Refresh and start a new conversation.
Published package updates and server rescans are publisher actions, with their own review and publication state. A local ZIP or GitHub release does not prove a directory update.
For a named installed extension, run gemini extensions update vpsnet in your terminal and restart the CLI.
/mcp reload re-discovers tools and /skills reload refreshes skills on host versions that support them; these do not install a new extension.
Manage the custom Connected App in Gemini settings. This remote connection is not a Gemini CLI extension.
The reviewed guide does not establish a package-upgrade or tool-cache refresh command.
For a local plugin copy, replace it with the complete reviewed new package and reload the window or restart.
Public marketplace updates require provider review; team marketplace sync and local updates are separate. No universal public-store update command is established here.
For a copied local installation, reinstall the reviewed complete source with /plugins install ./vpsnet, then /reload or start a new session.
Use the plugin manager update action where available. Do not assume custom VPSnet plugins auto-update.
Use Plugin Builder in Kimi Work to convert the reviewed source update and inspect the resulting package.
Personal installation and public marketplace review are separate; no automatic source-update contract was established.
For a repository-backed Power, use its Check for updates and Install updates controls.
Standalone MCP configuration is separate. Power OAuth scope compatibility needs client verification; installing a package does not grant additional scopes.
MCP: Reset Cached Tools refreshes discovery, not installed plugin files.
Use Extensions: Check for Extension Updates for the extension inventory. AgentHost /plugin update applies to its own plugin inventory; inspect which host and install source you use first.
For a Devin CLI plugin installation, use devin plugins update vpsnet. A linked local source reloads on a new session.
Legacy Cascade and Devin Local are different hosts; do not assume a Devin CLI action updates a legacy Cascade configuration.
Use qwen extensions update <installed-name> for a native installed extension, then restart after terminal changes.
Pinned exact npm versions remain pinned. Marketplace source refresh is separate from updating installed extensions.
Inspect the actual Cline host and installed source; plugin support differs between CLI/SDK and IDE extensions.
No custom-plugin automatic upgrade or remote tool-refresh guarantee was established. Use the host-native manager and current official instructions.
Use the existing Vibe Work connector controls. Its tool discovery is not dynamic; follow its documented reconnect procedure when tool definitions change.
Do not substitute Vibe Code CLI: direct OAuth MCP is not supported there by the reviewed documentation.
The reviewed Vibe Code CLI documentation explicitly excludes OAuth MCP servers. A plugin update does not fix that limitation.
Use a supported OAuth client; never substitute customer passwords or manually supplied tokens.
Manage the existing custom remote connector in account settings. Native skill ZIP replacement is a separate operation.
The reviewed connector guide does not establish automatic tool-list refresh, custom plugin upgrades or release notifications.
